Buddy moderately elongated continuous full charcoal torso, visible neck, substantial legs and actual floor clearance, modest head, pale muzzle beard/brows and pendant ear furnishings, light lower legs; short SMOOTH body coat and slender dark tail. N35 excludes anatomy; B08 styling only; B25 unavailable; B30 supplemental rest unused; B04/B24 one exposure. Humans provisional. No lettering. Counter and passport hand above establish immigration. No food visible. RIGHT scene detection at baggage claim: small tricolor beagle in plain working vest noses Neet’s canvas bag on tile floor. Neet stands beside bag caught and wide-eyed; Buddy a pace farther away freezes guiltily with all paws grounded. Carousel background, Heather lower body/hand above, official lower trouser legs opposite. NO olives yet visible. Stage all limb roots/support/connectivity clearly, avoid overlap tangles. Two distinct complete scenes.

selected_images.placement_after: Neet pressed his little bag behind his forelegs. Buddy looked straight ahead with the fierce concentration of a dog who had never met an olive.
selected_images.alt_text: Neet hides the bag while Buddy concentrates on looking innocent.

selected_images.placement_after: Buddy followed along the stationary edge as Neet rotated like a rotisserie chicken. He stopped at the next clear gap and barked. If Neet insisted on being luggage, someone had to be there to collect him.
selected_images.alt_text: Buddy waits at the clear pickup gap while Neet enjoys becoming part of the baggage.

selected_images.placement_after: He took one careful step away from the bag, then stopped. What if leaving looked suspicious? The beagle kept sniffing. Buddy stayed exactly where he was.
selected_images.alt_text: The detector beagle finds the bag while Buddy freezes one careful step away.
